text: In the case of a UN Regulation the series of amendments indicated reflects the version that has been published in the Official Journal of the European Union. Supplements to the series of amendments indicated in the Official Journal publication shall apply irrespective of publication in the Official Journal of the European Union. New series of amendments adopted after the series of amendments indicated in the Official Journal publication shall be accepted as an alternative.
